identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a 'Clean Retro' Christian e-commerce experience that fuses 80s nostalgia with modern faith aesthetics.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 80s Memphis design with modern clean SaaS layouts.
Emotion First: Every pixel should feel warm, welcoming, and joyful.
Content is King: Products are the heroes; the UI is the gallery.
Negative Space: Use generous cream-colored whitespace to let the bold colors breathe.
Contrast: High contrast borders and hard shadows (Neo-Brutalist Lite).

usage.primary: Main CTAs, Highlights, Brand Elements (Mustard Yellow)
usage.secondary: Sale tags, Urgent actions, Heart/Love motifs (Retro Red)
usage.background: Warm Cream/Paper texture feel - NEVER pure white #FFFFFF for page bg

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle grain or noise overlay on the background if possible to enhance the retro paper feel.

marketing_grid.name: The Tetris Grid
marketing_grid.description: Asymmetric grid for product showcases to avoid monotony.

dashboard_grid.name: The Control Room
dashboard_grid.description: Dense, data-heavy grid for the admin panel.

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use 'phosphor-icons' (Duotone) for feature highlights if available.

general: Implement the 'Clean Retro' theme by strictly adhering to the color palette and border/shadow rules.
Do NOT use default Tailwind shadows. Use the custom hard shadows defined in 'visual_enhancers'.
Ensure all interactive elements have the 'data-testid' attribute.
Use the 'Tetris Grid' for the homepage product showcase.
Use the 'Control Room' grid for the Admin Dashboard.
For the 'About' page, focus on storytelling with large typography and lifestyle images.
Authentication pages should be simple, centered cards with the signature hard shadow style.

universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic gradients, no 'Inter' font for headings, no soft/blurry shadows.
Spacing: Use generous padding (p-8, p-12) to let the design breathe.
Motion: Add hover states to EVERYTHING. Buttons should lift, cards should glow or lift.
Accessibility: Ensure text contrast is high (Black text on Cream bg is perfect).
Components: Use Shadcn/UI as the base, but HEAVILY customize the CSS to match the 'Neo-Brutalist Lite' style.
